name: The Jing’an collector
description: Collaborations, specialist boots and classic shoemaking in one Jing’an afternoon. Begin at Radiance Blue, loop through Classic Works and John Lobb, then finish at NOOS in Kerry Centre.
optionalTitle: Add Ralph Lauren at Kerry Centre
optionalNote: Visit the North Building boutique before or after NOOS in the South Building. Both are in the same complex.
note: Walk between the neighbourhood stops, leaving time for fitting. Radiance Blue is on Level 3 of Taikoo Hui; John Lobb is on B1 of Plaza 66. Confirm Classic Works’ hours before setting out.

name: The Xuhui shoe afternoon
description: A collector’s salon, Shanghai canvas shoes and footwear alongside tailoring. Start upstairs at Roiluxe, visit nearby Culture Matters, then continue south along the Wulumuqi corridor to The Anthology / Tassels.
optionalTitle: Continue southwest to NOOS One ITC
optionalNote: Make One ITC in Xujiahui a separate final leg. Walk or take a short taxi ride if you want more time for fitting.
note: Confirm access to Roiluxe’s Room 520 before visiting. Culture Matters is at 206 Wulumuqi Middle Road. La Maison is at 193 Wulumuqi South Road and lists Tuesday–Sunday, 12:30–20:30 hours.

name: The Xintiandi short circuit
description: Two nearby stops with different approaches to footwear: sneakers and collaborations at DOE, followed by artisanal leather shoes and boots at Rivets. Leave room for a browse around Xintiandi.
note: Begin at DOE, L1-W09, 168 Hubin Road. Continue to Rivets at L256, 2F, Building D, Xintiandi Dongtai Li, 111 Ji’an Road. Both stops are in Huangpu; no river crossing is needed. Confirm shop hours before visiting.

name: Julu, Changle & the avant-garde
description: Move from the broad footwear selection at Industrial Co. through specialist boots at The Real Real Co. and British and European shoes at BaronJ, then continue south to eth0s for experimental forms and leather.
optionalTitle: Begin with PANE and DOE Tongren
optionalNote: For a sneaker-focused opening, visit PANE on Yongyuan Road, then DOE at 78 Tongren Road, before joining the core route at Industrial Co. Choose fewer later stops to keep the afternoon relaxed.
note: Keep Industrial Co., The Real Real Co. and BaronJ together around Julu, Shaanxi South and Changle roads. Arrange BaronJ’s weekend or appointment access first; skip it if access is unavailable. Finish at eth0s, 253 Jiashan Road, on foot or with a short taxi ride.

name: The river crossing
description: Browse Purple Label footwear at the Peninsula Arcade, then cross the Huangpu for MEDALLION at Shipyard 1862. Make the waterfront part of the afternoon, with time to discuss fit and commissioning a pair.
optionalTitle: Begin in Hongkou at Frank’s Store
optionalNote: For vintage clothing and coffee, visit Frank’s Store at 229 Harbin Road before heading south to the Peninsula. Allow extra travel time for this neighbourhood detour.
note: Use a taxi or metro for the river crossing. Confirm MEDALLION’s visiting hours or appointment before leaving the Bund. The map line shows visit order; it is not a walking route across the river.

name: A visit to GentleMaker
description: A dedicated destination for care, repair and restoration, with an introduction to Zhou Ruoda’s shoemaking. Plan the visit around the work you want to discuss or the pair you would like to commission.
note: Confirm the visit at 629 Zhongjiang Road before travelling. Send photographs and discuss repair or commission enquiries ahead. Allow a separate journey to Changfeng; the central shopping circuits are farther east.
